name: wifi
description: Wi-Fi STA connection manager with timeout, retry, and hostname support. Wraps network.WLAN with a friendly interface and prints formatted status messages.

constructor_params.name: password
constructor_params.description: Wi-Fi password. Empty string '' for open networks.

constructor_params.name: timeout
constructor_params.description: Single connection attempt timeout in seconds

constructor_params.name: retry
constructor_params.description: Additional retries after first attempt (0 = no retry, 1 = total 2 attempts)

constructor_params.name: hostname
constructor_params.description: Optional DHCP hostname (accessible as hostname.local via mDNS)

properties.name: local_hostname
properties.description: hostname.local form (only set if hostname was provided)

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connect to the configured Wi-Fi network. Returns True on success, False on failure. Prints progress dots and status messages.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnect from Wi-Fi and update is_connected flag

methods.name: scan
methods.description: Scan available Wi-Fi networks, print them sorted by signal strength (descending), deduplicated by SSID. Returns the raw network list.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Interactive wizard: scan → prompt for SSID/password/timeout/retry/hostname → connect → print network info

methods.name: help
methods.description: Print full module documentation including signature, parameters, properties, methods, and example

example:
from wifi import WiFi

wifi = WiFi(ssid='your_ssid', password='your_pwd', hostname='my-esp32')
if wifi.connect():
    print('IP:', wifi.ip)
    print('Local:', wifi.local_hostname)
    wifi.disconnect()
esp32_notes: Calls network.WLAN(network.STA_IF) under the hood — see parent skill api/network.json for underlying behavior
If wlan.isconnected() is already True at start, connect() prints current config and returns True without re-connecting
Each retry cycle calls wlan.active(False) then wlan.active(True) to reset state — adds ~1s delay between attempts
network.hostname() may not be supported on all ports (silently caught with try/except)
For non-blocking connect, use parent skill network.WLAN directly — WiFi.connect() polls wlan.isconnected() with time.sleep(0.5)
After deep sleep, Wi-Fi credentials persist — call wlan.active(False) before soft-reset to clear
hardware_notes: Default credentials (stemstaroffice / ilovestem) target Stemstar office network — change for production use
Signal strength should be > -80 dBm for stable connection
differences_from_standard_mp: Standard MicroPython requires manually constructing WLAN, polling status, parsing ifconfig(). NovaMP WiFi wraps all of this.
NovaMP WiFi.scan() prints and deduplicates — standard wlan.scan() returns raw tuples with duplicate SSIDs at different BSSIDs
NovaMP WiFi prints emoji-decorated status messages — standard code is silent
